note: Demo videos of each MOD, recorded from the editor's headset view with the pipeline beside it (demos/record.mjs). Not part of the system: change a clip here and run `node demos/record.mjs <name>` to record it again. recording: a scenario of the space; ask_at: when (s) in the recording the question is asked; start/duration: the part of the replay recorded (the replay holds at the question while the answer comes); setup: MOD customizations applied while asking (as in the MODs tab), reset afterwards. agent_speed < 1 replays the agent's work in slow motion so each stage can be seen in turn (the video says so). devices: {entity: power} set before asking, so a device action starts from the same state. press: {at: s} presses an action card's confirm button (Send) at that second of the clip.
